liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Run Thru** (1 review): The track was described as extremely loud and physically overwhelming to the listener [3]
- Songs often shift tempo or direction before concluding with a massive jam session [7]
- The melodies are well-constructed and the band plays with significant force and energy [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **Golden**: with Kathleen Edwards [15]

## The recordings

- **mmj2005-10-23.ck63.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 15 songs; 89 min; rated 4.58/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: Reducing the bass level significantly improves the overall listening experience of the recording; Unlike typical murky audience recordings, this capture has good sound quality despite crowd noise [3][11]
- **mmj2005-10-23.ck63.flac24**: source not stated; 15 songs; 89 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: The twenty-four-bit version is considered superior to the sixteen-bit recording of the same show [6]

## Around the show

- Guests: Kathleen Edwards [1]
- A man with a camera videoed almost the entire performance at the venue [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2005-10-23.ck63.flac16**: taped by Jon Ice; transferred by Jon Ice; source: ck63 > Active Cables > JK Labs DVC > Apogee Mini-Me > M-Audio Microtrack 2496 @ 24/48 via AES output [1]
- **mmj2005-10-23.ck63.flac24**: taped by Jon Ice; transferred by Jon Ice; source: ck63 > Active Cables > JK Labs DVC > Apogee Mini-Me > M-Audio Microtrack 2496 @ 24/48 via AES output [2]
